# GeoZarr convention fixture sources

These fixtures are development oracles. Runtime code does not fetch them or the linked schemas.

- `geospatial-pyramid-v0.1.json` is copied from
  `zarr-conventions/multiscales/examples/geospatial-pyramid.json` at tag `v0.1`, commit
  `9b78efa75fef0fed302d9cf880037c569354d860`, blob
  `c8677cf56799ccbe1b903185ca5c1d7a7230f3e8`.
  Source: https://github.com/zarr-conventions/multiscales/blob/9b78efa75fef0fed302d9cf880037c569354d860/examples/geospatial-pyramid.json
- `spatial-proj-v0.1.json` is copied from
  `zarr-conventions/spatial/examples/proj.json` at tag `v0.1`, commit
  `54d81b7ced0376e63ee10f34db31db7d08dcc28d`, blob
  `66292b88d9627a2676d0d7f08a71d2e38cf60efc`.
  Source: https://github.com/zarr-conventions/spatial/blob/54d81b7ced0376e63ee10f34db31db7d08dcc28d/examples/proj.json
